In a meadow of fake identities, a ZK unique-human registry anchors each attester to a one-time nullifier hash registered on-chain — second proof from same nullifier rejected. Each epoch fresh proof with nonce; registry checks nullifier and bond.

Clone attacker must forge 500 distinct proofs — each needs separate 500-POA bond and separate secret. Total: 250,000 POA locked plus 500 unique secrets. Single clone = 500 POA + one secret; 500 clones ≈ $75,000.

A plume of 500 forged passports, each with biometric chip and $150 deposit — 500 real human traits needed to pass the grove.
